anchor.statement: Proposition 5.3. Fix the leading profiles of Theorem 4.6. There is a sequence of positive-order profiles constructed at each order by Lemma 5.1 and then Lemma 5.2, using the finalized lower orders. Every finite velocity sum u [N] slow is divergence-free. On every fixed compact profile range 0 ≤ X ≤ X max , −1 ≤ η ≤ 1, with 0 < X max < ∞ , for each N, m ≥ 0 and 0 < q ≤ 1, its augmented momentum residual satisfies |F slow (U [N] )| m ≤ C N,m q 2h(N+1)−K m, K m independent of N. (5.25) The constants may depend on the fixed profile range, and C N,m may depend on N; the exponent loss K m does not.

correspondence.note: The bound |F_slow(U[N])|_m ≤ C q^{2h(N+1)−K_m}, with K_m = 2 + 2h + m, is stated along approach filters q → 0 (one constant per approach), not uniformly for 0 < q ≤ 1. The constructed sequence enters through the finite-identity hypothesis, which FinalSlowBase.finiteIdentities states for the constructed profiles.

∀ {l : Filter NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpaceTime} {h C lo hi r : ℝ},
  0 < h →
    h < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ (A : NavierStokes.BaseResidual.PhysicalApproach l h lo hi),
        0 < r →
          ∀ {d : NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.Coefficients},
            NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.SmoothCoefficients d →
              NavierStokes.BaseResidual.StressZeroCore d r →
                ∀ (f : NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.SlowProfiles),
                  NavierStokes.BaseResidual.FiniteIdentities h C d f →
                    ∀ {O : Set NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.Inner},
                      IsOpen O →
                        NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.innerBox lo hi ⊆ O →
                          ∀ (N : ℕ) (phi u beta : ℕ → NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.Inner → ℝ),
                            (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (phi j) O) →
                              (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (u j) O) →
                                (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (beta j) O) →
                                  (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.flux j w = w.1 * beta j w) →
                                    (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.axial j w = u j w) →
                                      (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.phi j w = phi j w) →
                                        (∀ w ∈ O, NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.L h w.2 ≠ 0) →
                                          ∀ (M : ℕ),
                                            NavierStokes.DiagonalResidual.FiniteJetRate l
                                              (fun (z : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpaceTime) =>
                                                (NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.cartesianChart h z).1)
                                              (fun (z : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpaceTime) =>
                                                NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual
                                                    (NavierStokes.BaseResidual.prefixVelocity N h C d)
                                                    (NavierStokes.BaseResidual.prefixPressure N h C d) z.1 z.2 -
                                                  NavierStokes.BaseResidual.prefixStressForce N h C d z)
                                              M (2 * ↑N * h - 2 - ↑M)
